role: Explicit follow-up after the registered experiment showed strong common-input-genre results and weak primary seven-class results
question: Does the Romance versus Science Fiction distinction on thriller reviews remain under book-disjoint cross-validation of the 768 original development authors?
modeling: Exactly the same tokenizer, 29 metrics, three regularization options, inner selection, unweighted logistic regression and fixed naive Bayes. No new filters or models.
split: Exactly three book-hash folds, same function as the original protocol
diagnostics: Nearest training-text TFIDF cosine similarity for each of the 157 separate validation authors
Report performance after excluding evaluation bodies with maximum cosine >=0.8 without refitting
Inspect descriptive naive Bayes term contributions and errors; these are explanations, not separately confirmed word associations
scope: Only the already specified two preference groups and thriller-review context
decision: Assess whether a restricted version of the original objective is supported. The original seven-class primary gate remains failed regardless of follow-up outcomes.
